body.statement: For every fixed interior mean \(m\) with \(q>0\), the family \(P_{\rho}\) has mean \(m\), belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{bd}}\), satisfies \(b_{\mathrm{cyc}}(x)=-B^{-1}D_{\mu}^{-1}x\) and \(K(x)=K_0\), and therefore obeys \(\Gamma(x)=B^{-2}x^{\prime}D_{\mu}^{-1}K_0^{-1}D_{\mu}^{-1}x>0\) for every nonzero admissible \(x\). Moreover \(\mathbb B_{\mathcal A}(\Sigma_0,\delta_0)\subset\mathcal L(m)\), and the explicitly chosen \(x_0\) and \(\eta_0\) satisfy \(\mathbb B_{\mathcal A}(\Sigma(x_0),\eta_0)\subset\mathcal L(m)\) with \(\Gamma>0\) throughout that ambient open ball.
body.justification: Support-preserving realizability shows that strict inefficiency is robust and not an artifact of perturbing an impossible covariance matrix.
body.gap: The rank-one completion and additive efficient-DiD literatures do not construct a legal nonnegative fixed-support family with an exact positive-definite cohort-mean PPML loss form.
body.consumer: The family supplies calibrated stress tests and interpretable variance-loss directions for cohort-mean proportional PPML applications.
